I told Hollis in a reply to their #central-team thread that the Marrow Agrisupply inbound lane site is Gate 47. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I only used messages they can already see there.

- **What the channel shows:** on Oct 14, Pree posted Dock 23, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning. Nothing in the channel has changed it since.
- **gbrain:** searching it for the lane turned up nothing. It's running keyword-only, so that doesn't prove nothing exists, but the channel messages were enough to answer.

My reply to Hollis referred to Pree as "she," but Pree's pronouns haven't been stated. I can't edit the message. If you want, I can post a corrected version or leave it.
